title: Adapter
description: Per-implementation bridge from the tournament-protocol wire format to a candidate executable. The candidate reads one JSON object on stdin and writes one JSON value on stdout (tstournament protocol).

capability_id.description: The benchmark suite this adapter grades — one adapter per (target, suite) pair.

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. ${WORKBENCH_ROOT} is substituted to the SCIENTIST_WORKBENCH env var.

version.description: Recorded into grade_runs.candidate_version. Not pinned by the corpus; the user updates when re-running.

platform_pinned.description: If true, grade-runs record the platform fingerprint {arch, os, runtime} (ADR-0015 alignment with scientist-workbench numerical tier).
